description: This connection has no account: it builds into an unclaimed studio. Returns the claim link to give the user (a free sign-up or log-in that moves the studio's games into their own account), when the studio expires, and whether it has been claimed already. connect_account is the better way to keep the games when the user is here (this session then keeps working as their account); the claim link is for later, or for someone else.
name: claim_studio
title: Get the claim link for this unclaimed studio
